title: 28 Shanliss Way, Dublin 9, Santry, Dublin 9, D09E447
seoTitle: 28 Shanliss Way, Dublin 9, Santry, Dublin 9, D09E447
description:
Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to present 28 Shanliss Way to the market. This spacious four-bedroom, four-bathroom semi-detached family home is ideally positioned on this established residential road in Santry. The property has been extended to the rear and benefits from a converted attic with en-suite, providing generous and versatile accommodation over three floors.

On entering, there is an enclosed porch leading to a welcoming hallway with semi-solid timber flooring and useful under-stair storage. To the front is a generous living room with feature fireplace, large picture window and fitted shelving.

To the rear, the property has been extended to create an impressive kitchen and dining/family space. The extensive fitted kitchen features ample oak units  with granite counter tops and an island, while the bright vaulted dining area provides plenty of space for family living and entertaining, with patio doors opening onto the rear garden. A utility area and guest WC complete the ground floor.

Upstairs, there are four bedrooms including a spacious primary bedroom with wall-to-wall fitted wardrobes. The rear double bedroom overlooks the garden, while the single bedroom to the front is ideally suited as a child's bedroom or home office. The first floor also features a family bathroom and a separate shower room.

The converted attic provides an excellent additional space with various uses such as home office/playroom, together with a an en-suite containing, W.C. and roof windows providing plenty of natural light.

Outside, the property benefits from a gated front garden with a paved driveway providing off-street parking. To the rear is a long, private and fully enclosed garden with lawn, raised patio and mature planting. A detached block-built workshop with power and separate access provides useful additional storage or hobby space.

The property is conveniently located close to a wide range of amenities in Santry, including local shops, schools, parks, sports facilities and Dublin City University. There are excellent transport links nearby, with easy access to the M1, M50 and Dublin Airport, while Dublin city centre is also readily accessible by public transport.
